subject: Billing contact + e-invoice onboarding (portal vs email) - Novus
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novus-inc.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus AP <ap@novus-inc.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Billing contact + e-invoice onboarding

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We're ready to set up billing for the HorizonPay pilot (PO 84239 attached). Two quick asks as we onboard:

1) We prefer machine-readable e-invoices (UBL) pushed to a portal/endpoint. Is Redwood able to push UBL or provide an SFTP/webhook?
2) AP needs a primary billing contact listed on invoices and a backup for exceptions. Can you confirm a billing contact name/email and whether Redwood will send a PDF copy to finance@novus-inc.com as a fallback?

Note: For EU shipments we'll need VAT reverse-charge annotations on invoices. We'll include the VAT ID in the PO.

I've attached the PO and a sample UBL our AP team accepts. Let me know if you need any onboarding forms or a point-of-contact for our ERP team.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Senior AP Analyst
Novus, Inc.
attachments: [Novus_PO_84239.pdf, UBL_sample.xml]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novus-inc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing contact + e-invoice onboarding

Hi Sophie — great to hear we're moving forward. Quick responses below and next steps: 

- E-invoice delivery: We support multiple delivery patterns. For Novus' use case the recommended approach is: portal-first (REST webhook or SFTP push) with PDF copies emailed to a designated finance mailbox for the first 90 days while you validate receipts in ERP. We can export UBL with the standard tags you shared.
- VAT/reverse-charge: We can tag invoices with the reverse-charge note and include the VAT ID field. Please confirm the exact VAT ID you will use on PO 84239.
- Billing contact: For the pilot we can designate a Redwood billing contact and a backup. Ben will be the billing owner for collection orchestration; Kimberly will be the escalation and billing contact for contractual items. Either or both can be on the invoice header.

Next steps:
1) Ben to confirm the delivery webhook/SFTP details and a sample payload.
2) Sophie to confirm VAT ID for PO 84239 and whether Novus prefers webhook or SFTP.
3) We will send a portal onboarding form for signatures and a short test file.

I'll CC our AP engineer and billing ops to keep this tight.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Subject: Re: Billing contact + e-invoice onboarding — delivery options

Hi Sophie, Grace —

I can take the delivery lead. Quick notes: 
- We can POST UBL to a webhook with mutual TLS, or push files to SFTP. Webhook gives near real-time delivery and simpler reconciliation if Novus can accept acknowledgements (HTTP 200/202). SFTP is fine if your ERP team prefers file drops and batch processing.
- Sample payload: attached UBL_sample.xml is close to what we'll produce; I'll send a UBL with Redwood-specific invoice-id and VAT tag for your test.
- PDF copies: we'll enable an email fan-out to finance@novus-inc.com as a fallback. We'll keep emails to a single mailbox and add an 'X-Redwood-Invoice-Origin' header for traceability.

Please confirm: webhook (mTLS) or SFTP? Also Sophie, can you confirm the VAT ID for PO 84239 so I can include the correct reverse-charge note?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: [UBL_sample.xml]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novus-inc.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing contact + e-invoice onboarding — agreement and next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick responses. Per internal alignment, Redwood will proceed with the following for the HorizonPay pilot (PO 84239):

- Delivery: Portal-first — we'll provision a webhook endpoint (mTLS) and send a one-off test UBL within 48 hours. If Novus prefers SFTP instead, we can do that; confirm by EOD.
- Fallback: PDF copies to finance@novus-inc.com for the first 90 days (then portal-only unless you request otherwise).
- Billing contact on invoice header:
  Primary: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
  Backup/escalation: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
- VAT/reverse-charge: Sophie, please reply with the VAT ID to include on the invoice. We'll add the reverse-charge note and your VAT ID in the UBL taxonomy.

I've attached the portal onboarding form; please sign and return the novus_portal_onboarding_form.pdf and we'll kick off provisioning. Once we receive the signed form and VAT ID we'll send the test UBL and confirm the schedule for the automated pushes.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Billing & Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: [novus_portal_onboarding_form.pdf]
